$comment: Knobs for the autonomous loop (workflow/skills/loop-run). Read fresh from main on every routine run, so merging a change here changes the next run with no redeploy. The reflection rung proposes edits to this file as a PR.

ceilings.$comment: Structural rationing. A cloud session cannot read the account's remaining quota, so spend is bounded by work-item counts rather than token math. Never split an implementation across runs: the WIP check decides whether to start one at all.

surveyCalendar.$comment: Weekday -> survey skill, morning runs only. Weekends run no surveys. Keys are lowercase UTC weekday names as produced by `date -u +%A | tr A-Z a-z`.

analysisAngles: feature research against current best practice

sentry.$comment: Slugs filled in during Phase D. SahajAtlasWordpress ships no Sentry.

mailpit.$comment: Basic-auth credentials live in the cloud environment as MAILPIT_UI_AUTH, never here.

journalIssueNote: Current month's pinned Ops journal in claude-workflow. loop-run rung 6 opens the next month's issue on the first run of a month and updates this number in the same PR.
